name: world-landscape
summary: A level built from one data file: hills, paint layers and scattered meshes made with the engine's Landscape and PCG tools, rebuilt by one command.
adapt: Enable the PCG plugin in the .uproject for the scatter stage (the first editor start after enabling plugins can take several minutes).
Edit Tools/gam3/world/layout.py: MAP, ROOT, the height function, the layers, and real meshes in SCATTER.
Replace the plain-colour ground material with textures when you have them (see ground_material in build_world.py).

verified.how: build.mjs built the example layout in a fresh project with PCG enabled: 253x253 landscape, two paint layers, lighting, 3,654 scattered instances, level saved. A game capture showed the road and clearing bare and the scatter around them. Larger landscapes and real foliage meshes were not run with this kit.
